subject: 44 Bradley Road Historic District
overview: The Commission voted to initiate the process for designating 44 Bradley Road as a single-property historic district and approved a formal letter opposing state Senate Bill S.993.

items.title: 44 Bradley Road Single Property Historic District
items.summary: Approved initiating the process to designate 44 Bradley Road as a single-property historic district, with final designation deferred until exterior renovations are substantially complete.

items.title: Legislative Letter Opposing S.993
items.summary: Approved a formal letter in opposition to Massachusetts Senate Bill S.993, citing concerns that the legislation would reduce local historic district regulatory oversight on housing development projects.

items.title: South Street District Signage Meeting Logistics
items.summary: Finalized the logistics for an upcoming walking tour and meeting on September 16th to locate and plan new signage within the South Street Historic District.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the August session.
